sourceLimitations: Storefront bodies can contain examples, replacement notices and historical comparisons. Classification uses current primary rows or explicit own-core descriptions; uncertain accessories remain unreviewed.

Host kits are kept separate; no repeated Atom-Lite/Core design counted as a new independent MCU solely due to a kit SKU.

Second pass reviewed the remaining363 current primary descriptions/specifications/Includes. Source identity conflict A072 and unpinned kit host revisions are explicit; zero not-reviewed is not a complete PCB/BOM/model/runtime claim.
